'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Mike Stirling LS Hoth''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Stirling]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name box blank. Facing-page pair with [[Mike Stirling]] Dark My Lord, Is That Legal? (p25), between Jake from State Farm (p23–p24) and Mitch Nieland (Part 2 p01).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
